lead: Each theme lists its questions and how many datasets can answer them.
empty: No themes yet. Use “Make a new theme” and write what you want to know.

card.noQuestions: This theme has no questions yet.
card.removeConfirm: Remove the theme “{{label}}”? Concepts and relations that no other theme or data uses are removed too.
card.byAi: A person confirmed an AI draft
card.removed: Removed the theme “{{label}}”. {{concepts}} concepts and {{relations}} relations that nothing else uses are gone too ({{kept}} concepts kept).

wizard.aria: Build from what you want to know
wizard.title: Build from what you want to know (theme)

write.lead: Write what you want to know, one per line. The theme name can stay empty.
write.themeNamePlaceholder: If empty, the AI names it (e.g. Thermoelectric materials)
write.questions: What you want to know (one per line)
write.questionsPlaceholder: e.g. What can lower thermal conductivity?
write.aiOff: No AI is set up. You can write by hand.

read.badShape: The AI's answer was not in the fixed shape.

unconfigured.title: The AI is not set up
unconfigured.body: It cannot read the questions because no AI is set up. You can add concepts yourself (set it up any time from Settings).

failed.title: Could not make the AI draft
failed.body: Try again, or write by hand. Your questions are kept as they are.

place.lead: Confirms {{concepts}} concepts and {{relations}} relations in the theme “{{label}}” ({{questions}} questions).
place.leadExtend: Confirms {{concepts}} concepts and {{relations}} relations in “{{label}}” and adds {{questions}} questions.
place.questions: Questions and how they are answered
place.idBad: An ID starts with a lowercase letter and uses only lowercase letters, digits and _.
place.idTaken: This ID is already used. Choose another.
place.idDuplicate: Two concepts have the same ID.
place.memoQuestion: Memo question (no way of answering yet)

blocker.label: A concept has no name. Go back to step 2 and fix it.
blocker.slug: A concept has an ID in the wrong form.

place.noDraft: The draft could not be saved, so it cannot be placed.

term.back: Back to what you want to know
term.noDecisions: No decisions about this term yet.
term.draftedBy: On {{date}}, a person confirmed an AI draft
term.byHand: Made by a person, by hand

review.lead: Look at the figure, fix it by talking on the right, then confirm everything at once.
review.leadEmpty: No concepts yet. Talk it over on the right, or add one with "Add by hand".

problem.same: Cannot join a concept to itself (will not be confirmed)
problem.mixed: A kind and an item cannot be joined (will not be confirmed)
problem.cycle: It would go in a circle (will not be confirmed)
problem.quantity_target: “Quantity” joins an item to a quantity kind only (will not be confirmed)
problem.target_not_property: Lowers, raises and changes need an item as the other end (will not be confirmed)

review.aiOff: AI is not set up, so the conversation is off. You can still add by hand.
review.unlinkedNote: {{n}} concepts that do not connect to a question are left out.
review.leadHand: Add concepts, choose how each question is answered, then confirm them together.
review.thinNote: {{n}} faint proposals are not counted until you answer "Yes".
review.leadNarrow: Look at the figure, fix it by talking below, then confirm everything at once.
review.leadEmptyNarrow: No concepts yet. Talk it over below, or add one with "Add by hand".

answer.label: Answered as:
answer.noConcepts: Add a concept first, then you can pick it.

map.empty: No figure yet. Talk it over on the right, or add a concept with "Add by hand".
map.expandOff: Needs an AI to be set up
map.handle: End of the relation: drag onto another card to re-point it
map.emptyNarrow: No figure yet. Talk it over below, or add a concept with "Add by hand".

chat.title: Consult
chat.placeholder: Write a line (a question, a fix, or "is it true that …?")
chat.unset: Add a key in Settings › AI to consult
chat.failed: Could not make a proposal. Please rephrase and try again. {{detail}}
chat.noDraft: The draft was not found. Close it and reopen from where you left off.
chat.edgeDragHint: You can also drag the ring at the arrowhead onto another card.

dropped.unknown_key: It named a concept that is not on the figure, so it was not applied
dropped.same: A concept cannot be tied to itself
dropped.mixed: A kind and a property cannot be tied together
dropped.cycle: It would go around in a circle, so it was not applied
dropped.quantity_target: "Quantity" only ties a property to a quantity kind
dropped.target_not_property: Lowers, raises and changes only take a property
dropped.dismissed: You said "No" to this before, so it was not applied
dropped.not_found: It was not found on the figure, so it was not applied
dropped.limit: The limit was reached, so it was not applied
dropped.dataset_only: Only available in the data conversation
dropped.unsupported: Cannot be applied on this screen

droppedShort.unknown_key: names a concept that is not on the figure
droppedShort.mixed: a kind and a property cannot be tied
droppedShort.cycle: it would go around in a circle
droppedShort.quantity_target: "quantity" only ties a property to a quantity kind
droppedShort.target_not_property: the other end must be a property
droppedShort.unsupported: cannot be applied on this screen
